name: git-tag-policy
description: Generic git tagging automation for versioned repositories. Configure via vars.gitTag.* (prefix, remote, container).

post-push.description: Create and push a git tag for the resolved version if it does not already exist.

steps.run: git fetch --tags {{options.remote | default(vars.gitTag.remote, 'origin')}} && if git rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/tags/{{vars.gitTag.prefix}}{{version.SemVer}}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo TAG_EXISTS; fi

git push {{options.remote | default(vars.gitTag.remote, 'origin')}} --delete "refs/tags/{{vars.gitTag.prefix}}{{version.SemVer}}" || true && git tag -d "{{vars.gitTag.prefix}}{{version.SemVer}}" || true
